# 05-software

Firmware and control software: development environment, software safety requirements, architecture of the deterministic safety layer, safety analysis, unit design and verification, integration, validation on target, safety parameters, ML engineering of the locomotion policy, cybersecurity implementation.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §7–§8 and §10, IEC 61508-3 §7, IEC 62443-4-1 SI and SVV, MISRA C:2012, ISO/IEC TR 5469, ASPICE SWE.1–6, MLE.1–4.
